title: bl_forge.py reads merge request and pipeline state and merges, through a glab arm and a gh arm, from the configured forge and project
goal: _tools/bl_forge.py holds one read of a merge request (by title prefix or branch: merged, opened with pipeline status and detailed merge status, closed) and of the newest pipeline of a ref, each with a glab arm and a gh arm chosen by a new backlog.json setting forge (gitlab by default) and the one project of forge_project (else the integration remote's URL), and the merge of the item's own request on the glab arm only (the gh arm reads state and its merge verb refuses, so no agent merges on the public home); the gh arm is tested on recorded fixtures only, the glab arm on fixtures of the same shape

gates.question: Does the gh arm of bl_forge merge a pull request, or only read state?
options: read only: the gh arm reads state and the merge verb refuses on github, so no agent merges on the public home
read and merge with gh pr merge, which needs an allow rule in .claude/settings.json
gates.recommendation: read only: the gh arm reads state and the merge verb refuses on github, so no agent merges on the public home
gates.answer: read only: the gh arm reads state and the merge verb refuses on github, so no agent merges on the public home

gates.question: The new forge setting needs its key in the kb's committed backlog.json, which test_backlog_config_of_the_kb_is_its_committed_file_and_its_defaults requires of every setting, and neither backlog.json nor _tools/test_backlog_portable.py is in this item's touches: which does the item do?
options: widen the item's touches by backlog.json and add "forge": "gitlab" there (one line; the test then passes unchanged)
leave backlog.json alone and widen the touches by _tools/test_backlog_portable.py to let that test accept a setting the committed file leaves out
gates.recommendation: widen the item's touches by backlog.json and add "forge": "gitlab" there (one line; the test then passes unchanged)
gates.answer: widen the item's touches by backlog.json and add "forge": "gitlab" there (one line; the test then passes unchanged)

gates.question: How many merge requests does one bl_forge read list to find the request of a branch or a title prefix?
options: the CLIs' own default of 20 to 30

gates.question: In what words does the gh arm answer a pull request's pipeline and merge state: translated to the glab arm's words, or as gh prints them?
options: the glab arm's words for the pipeline (running, pending, failed, canceled, manual, skipped, success), mergeStateStatus lower case as merge_status, and mergeable true for CLEAN, UNSTABLE and HAS_HOOKS
gh's own words: status and conclusion as gh prints them, mergeStateStatus as it is
gates.recommendation: the glab arm's words for the pipeline (running, pending, failed, canceled, manual, skipped, success), mergeStateStatus lower case as merge_status, and mergeable true for CLEAN, UNSTABLE and HAS_HOOKS
gates.answer: the glab arm's words for the pipeline (running, pending, failed, canceled, manual, skipped, success), mergeStateStatus lower case as merge_status, and mergeable true for CLEAN, UNSTABLE and HAS_HOOKS
